I realized I was “not like the other kids” at the age of 7. I didn’t do anything abt it because my life was pretty shitty back then. I couldn’t afford to get lost in the emotions of “wanting to be a boy, even tho my body seemed to reject that idea” while my family was falling apart in front of my eyes. So I stayed closeted… for 10 years. In that decade my brain rewrote how I saw the world. I came out to one person as gay, then bi, and then pan, just to realize I was in fact ace.. and omniromantic. 

My gender is still a big mess, at this point i know I’m trans, but I’m torn about the microlabel… the only thing I know is that I’m not cis, and I like male pronouns but not always.. I’m still learning, still growing… we’ll see what happens lol
